Capture: MaixCAM2 stationary, 2026-10-30, 320x240 raw panel from HTTP capture.
seven_bars.png: user placed car 40–60 cm ahead of the missed crossing.
bend_without_crossing.png: same camera pose, bend with no crossing.
calibration.json is frozen at capture time; do not substitute the current device calibration.
Exposure, local-shadow and blur variants are generated in test_crosswalk_contrast.py.
The variations reproduce photometric failure; they are not a recording of the original moving miss.
